brief: Wenzl, Hecke algebras of type A_n and subfactors (Invent. Math. 92, 349–383, 1988) — semisimple quotients of H_n(q) at q = e^{2πi/l} labelled by (k,l) Young diagrams, and the subfactors with trivial relative commutant they give.
extended:
**Hecke algebras of type A_n and subfactors** — Hans Wenzl. Inventiones mathematicae 92, 349–383 (1988).

§1 generalises Jones' basic construction to inclusions of AF algebras A_n ⊂ B_n under a commuting-square condition (ε_{A_{n+1}} ε_{B_n} = ε_{A_n}); when the inclusion matrices are eventually periodic the index [B:A] is the squared norm of the inclusion matrix, and the relative commutant is bounded by dim pA_n'B_np. §2 builds representations of H_n(q) (Hoefsmit/Young orthogonal form, modified so they exist at a primitive l-th root of unity) whose images are semisimple, with irreducible components indexed by (k,l) diagrams: Young diagrams with at most k rows whose first and k-th rows differ by at most l−k. It also classifies the C*-representations of H_n(q) (all q except two cases). §3 computes the indices of the resulting subfactors of the hyperfinite II_1 factor, including Markov-trace weights and index formulas as ratios of products of sin²(·π/l); for each irreducible SU(k) representation the indices converge to its squared dimension as l → ∞. Jones' index-<4 subfactors are the SU(2) standard case.

**Why it may bear here.** The primary source for the Jones–Wenzl-type semisimple quotient of the Hecke tower at a root of unity, its (k,l)-diagram labelling, and the Markov trace weights on it. The bib key wenzl1988 already exists in references.bib.
